# Structured exit probes

These six informed complete sources were saved before diagnostic repair for
Issue #37. Attempt 01 was refused for a wrong manifest schema key before any
source parsing; those exact files and actual refusals remain retained. Attempt
02 changes only that key and obtains the real source outcomes: five syntax
refusals and one accepted ordinary identifier control. Neither a declaration
named `panic` nor a binding/function named `return` creates an exit edge.
The session record binds original sources, manifests and actual command
observations; it does not execute recorded commands or claim a semantic proof.
